system.description: Problem-solvers, infiltrators, engineers, field medics, tacticians, and manipulators who win by understanding what is likely to happen before it occurs.
system.benefit: Gain one additional Cunning Expertise and two additional Cunning Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Cunning to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Cunning Expertise and four additional Cunning Action Cards.

origin.name: Branching Plans
origin.text: You may establish a second Contingency each round. You may still trigger only one Contingency per round.
